title: Ninh Binh Tet travel experience
excerpt: With just 3 days and 2 nights, you can fully explore the beauty of Ninh Binh, visit famous destinations and discover new things during the spring, and below is the Ninh Binh Tet travel experience that Vietlook Travel wants to share with you
html:
With just 3 days and 2 nights, you can fully explore the beauty of Ninh Binh, visit famous destinations and discover new things during the spring, and below is the Ninh Binh Tet travel experience that Vietlook Travel wants to share with you.

Ninh Binh from January to March of the lunar calendar is the most beautiful time, the cool weather is very suitable for tourists to go sightseeing. Especially going to the temple to pray for luck.

Come with Vietlook Travel to Ninh Binh tour during Tet to experience the most interesting things, visit most of the tourist attractions in Ninh Binh.

When traveling to Ninh Binh during Tet, you should visit the ancient capital Hoa Lu where King Ly Thai To decided to move the capital, if you are a lover of ancient Vietnamese architecture history, you should visit once to visit and learn about Vietnamese culture.

The scenery of Ninh Binh is very poetic and charming with the quality of the Northern Delta, the air is fresh and cool all year round, a charming beauty of mountains and rivers.

Hang Mua Ninh Binh is the first destination that tourists cannot miss when coming to Ninh Binh, however, the most beautiful time to visit Hang Mua is at dawn or dusk, watching the sparkling scenery is especially suitable for spring travel.

Trang An World Heritage Site is a destination sought by many young people, visiting Co Vien Lau where the image of a simple and rustic village is almost intact.

Bich Dong Pagoda is famous for its majestic and poetic landscape, so when coming here, in addition to admiring the towering rocks, visitors can also admire the scenery, especially when traveling to Ninh Binh at the beginning of the year, visiting Bich Dong Pagoda is also an occasion for many tourists to come to worship at the pagoda.

Hoa Lu Ancient Town, visitors will feel like they are in Hoi An, because here visitors can also release lanterns, which will bring visitors the most enjoyable experience.

To explore the beauty of Trang An, visitors should spend a morning or afternoon to fully explore the beauty of Trang An, if going by boat, it will take 2 hours, in addition, you also have time to sit on the shore to enjoy the scenery to relax your soul.

Hoa Lu Ancient Capital is a destination exclusively for visitors who love to explore ancient beauty and want to learn about Vietnamese culture. In addition, visitors can also visit Tuyet Tinh Coc with a clear lake and a vast green forest scene right below a peaceful scene.

An indispensable destination in the Ninh Binh Tet Tour is Bai Dinh Pagoda, a pagoda with a spacious design and a majestic location that will exude a peaceful beauty.

Festivals held in Ninh Binh during Tet

Truong Yen Festival (Hoa Lu Festival)

This is one of the major festivals held in Ninh Binh, the festival usually lasts from 8 to 10 days, in early spring, the festival takes place to commemorate the great contributions of King Dinh Tien Hoang and King Le Dai Hanh.

The ceremony includes two solemn rituals: the water procession and the sacrifice ceremony. The ceremony also includes activities such as the great memorial service, the lantern ceremony, folk games: human chess, boat racing, tug of war, cockfighting, swinging, attractive sports competitions such as: traditional wrestling, volleyball… or competitions of singing Chau Van, poetry reading, poetry contest, word pulling, stick dancing, dragon dancing, lion dancing…

Duc Thanh Nguyen Temple Festival

Born on October 15, 1065, he had great merit in curing the illness of King Ly and the people, and he was the inventor of bronze casting.

Duc Thanh Nguyen Temple is one of the ancient temples, and was ranked as a National Architectural and Artistic Monument in February 1989. The festival of Duc Thanh Nguyen Temple takes place in early spring. Attending the festival, visitors can also participate in many folk games such as tug of war, 32-piece chess, cockfighting, volleyball, soccer…

Thai Vi Temple Festival

The festival takes place in early spring, so if you go to Ninh Binh in spring, visitors will be immersed in the atmosphere of the festival. On the day of the festival, people also offer the king a bowl of white rice to show their purity…

Trang An Festival

One of the unique festivals in Ninh Binh, and takes place in a clear blue water frame, with magical shimmering caves, surrounded by mountains and rivers.

If you are a lover of admiring the scenery of Trang An, you definitely cannot miss this festival, the festival takes place in a vibrant atmosphere, surrounded by poetic scenery.

With the Ninh Binh travel experiences that Vietlook Travel has just shared above, we hope it will help your trip. We wish you the happiest Tet holiday.
